research_question: Can a conservative Japanese morphology-aware semantic matcher reduce lexical-gate false negatives without introducing new critical false positives, before any runtime integration?

motivation.observed_problem: V31 rejected a natural candidate containing お疲れ when the required marker was おつかれ, and current substring matching is also insensitive to inflection and proposition polarity.
motivation.project_relevance: The same matcher affects both research metrics and whether a model-generated reply may replace the deterministic fallback, so verifier error can look like model error and can suppress otherwise usable conversation.
motivation.not_test_specific: The treatment uses Japanese morphological features and polarity checks rather than adding V29 answer strings or case IDs.

external_evidence.title: Large Language Models Can Be Easily Distracted by Irrelevant Context
external_evidence.relevance: Motivates reducing misleading or redundant lexical checks, but does not prove this matcher will improve UruhaBrain.

external_evidence.title: Stages in the speaking process
external_evidence.relevance: Separates a preverbal communicative message from linguistic formulation; V32 tests only the software boundary between intended concepts and surface wording, not biological equivalence.

external_evidence.title: pyopenjtalk
external_evidence.relevance: The installed OpenJTalk frontend exposes Japanese dictionary forms and readings used for the shadow treatment.

legacy_control.definition: The frozen current RightBrain._semantic_marker_hit behavior from the bound runtime.

lemma_polarity.definition: Legacy behavior plus dictionary-form matching for Japanese content words, with matched adjective/verb polarity required to agree. No pronunciation-only matching.

lemma_polarity_reading.definition: lemma_polarity plus pronunciation matching for kana markers against kanji surface forms; retained as a risk-bearing exploratory condition because homophones may create false positives.

controlled_variables: same required marker groups from the frozen V29 cases
no model generation, retraining, prompt change, answer rewriting, or human rating

secondary: V31 newly recovered semantic-only candidate count
V31 newly accepted candidate count after preserving all other rejection reasons
V31 strict seed-case coverage delta by payload condition
outcomes.candidate_boundary: V31 candidate results are retrospective diagnostics from previously observed development cases, not an independent holdout.

order: discard any treatment with a new critical false positive
discard any treatment with negative specificity below legacy control
among remaining treatments choose highest positive recall

research_boundary: This is an internally authored calibration set plus retrospective frozen V31 candidates. Passing can justify only a fresh source-separated verifier holdout. It cannot promote runtime, establish semantic entailment in general, prove human-like cognition, or validate pronunciation matching across Japanese homophones.
